content.summary: Synthesized explorer findings on subagent TUI updates - identified root cause and options

investigation_summary.root_cause: MCP tool calls don't propagate metadata because tool_use_id/callID is missing in MCP handlers, causing ctx.metadata calls to no-op. Additionally, ToolMetadataRegistry stores metadata but has no retrieval path wired into tool_use_summary processing.

key_files.tool_bridge: packages/opencode/src/provider/native/tool-bridge.ts - MCP server for tools, callID missing
key_files.task_tool: packages/opencode/src/tool/task.ts - subscribes to child session events, updates metadata

investigation_summary.current_behavior: Task UI shows agent name from props.input.subagent_type, tool count from metadata.summary, but metadata updates from child session are not propagating through MCP path

options.name: Restore Task metadata propagation for MCP tools
options.approach: Fix tool_use_id/callID availability in tool-bridge.ts and wire ToolMetadataRegistry.retrieve() into tool_use_summary processing

options.name: TUI-side child session mirroring
options.approach: When Task metadata has sessionId, sync child session and render its tool parts inline

options.name: Server-side aggregation of subagent tool progress
options.approach: Mirror child tool updates into parent session metadata/event stream
